definition_en: a planned series of actions to achieve a goal
core_image: 一群人举着标语走街串巷
scene: 选举前最后一周，志愿者挨家敲门。They ran a campaign to save the library.
sceneCN: 这里 campaign 是「运动」（第 1 个义项：为某目标开展的一系列行动）；句意是他们发起了一场拯救图书馆的运动。

pos.zh: 动词：参加竞选；开展运动

derivatives.zh: 运动参与者，奔走呼吁的人

senses.title: An organized drive for a goal
senses.definition: a planned set of actions aimed at changing something
senses.definitionCN: 为改变某事而策划的一系列行动
senses.example: They ran a campaign to save the library.
senses.exampleCN: 他们发起了一场拯救图书馆的运动。
senses.why: The core image is a group marching with banners through streets.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一群人举着标语在街上游行。

senses.title: A series of military operations
senses.definition: a connected series of battles fought for one aim
senses.definitionCN: 为同一目标进行的一系列战斗
senses.example: The winter campaign ended in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季战役在群山中结束。
senses.why: The word first named armies taking the field for a season.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早指军队开赴野外作战的一个季节。

senses.title: To work for a cause or office
senses.definition: to take part in a planned effort to win support or votes
senses.definitionCN: 参与争取支持或选票的有计划行动
senses.example: She campaigned for a seat on the council.
senses.exampleCN: 她为争取议会席位参加竞选。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for taking part in such an effort.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，指参与这类行动。

intro.en: Campaign came from the Italian word for open country.
intro.cn: campaign 来自意大利语里表示开阔乡野的词。

items.cn: 拉丁语 campus 意为田野。
意大利语 campagna 指开阔乡野。

items.en: campagne named a season of military operations.
items.cn: 法语 campagne 指一个作战季节。

items.en: English campaign first meant a military campaign.
items.cn: 英语 campaign 最初指军事战役。

items.en: Campaign covers elections, publicity and the verb to campaign.
items.cn: 现代英语中 campaign 兼指竞选、宣传与开展运动。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the camp base; the near-meaning group gives other organized efforts.
note.cn: 形近组共用 camp 词基；近义组是其他有组织的行动。

entries.definition: a person who works for a cause
the activity of running a campaign
an organized effort to reach a goal
a long energetic campaign for a cause

normalIntro.en: Campaign moved from a field of battle to a drive for votes.
normalIntro.cn: campaign 从战场走到了争取选票的运动。

normal.en: Launch a campaign means start one.
normal.cn: launch a campaign 义为发起运动。

normal.en: A campaigner works for a cause.
The word is related to camp.
normal.cn: 这个词与 camp 同源。

abstract.en: See banners moving down a narrow street.
abstract.cn: 想象横幅在窄街上前移。

abstract.en: See a hand knock on door after door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手一户接一户敲门。

abstract.en: See a map marked with arrows across a valley.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上山谷间画满箭头。

examples.en: They ran a campaign to save the library.
examples.cn: 他们发起了一场拯救图书馆的运动。

examples.en: The winter campaign ended in the mountains.
examples.cn: 冬季战役在群山中结束。

examples.en: She campaigned for a seat on the council.
examples.cn: 她为争取议会席位参加竞选。

dict_mnemonic.text: camp 是营地，aign 像一串脚步，一群人从营地出发一路宣传，就成了一场运动。

root: campaign 经法语 campagne 上溯到意大利语 campagna、拉丁语 campus（田野），本指军队在野外作战的一个季节，后指社会运动与竞选。

sensesIntro.en: An organized drive, a season of battles, and the act of seeking support.
sensesIntro.cn: 有组织的运动、一个作战季节，以及争取支持的行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: banners moving through a street.
core.cn: 核心意象：横幅在街道上前移。

intro.en: Campaign takes -er and -ing to name people and activity.
intro.cn: campaign 能加 -er 与 -ing，指人与活动。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin campus, a field.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 campus，意为田野。

items.meaning: a cause taken up with zeal
a formal choice in an election
